metadata.title: CJ Donaldson - Sees extra work in garbage time
metadata.description: Donaldson logged three carries for 18 yards and caught both of his targets for five yards during the Saints' 45-24 loss to the Falcons on Monday. He also added a tackle on special teams.
metadata.analysis: All of Donaldson's offensive production came on the Saints' final drive of the contest, when the game was already well out of reach. His 28 offensive snaps ended up being tied with Alvin Kamara for most among Saints running backs, with Kendre Miller (19) not far behind. Donaldson was more efficient with his touches than both Kamara and Miller, but for as much as the Saints' run game struggled in the absence of Travis Etienne (hamstring), it's hard to envision Donaldson as the lead back in New Orleans for the foreseeable future. That said, if Donaldson is trusted by head coach Kellen Moore as a backfield blocker on pass protection, then he could operate in an elevated role in Week 5 against the Vikings and their blitz-happy defense under defensive coordinator Brian Flores.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson Could see Expanded Role in Backfield
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints running back CJ Donaldson has seen a minimal role in the rushing attack through the first three weeks of the season. Coming into Week 4, Donaldson has carried the ball four times for 11 yards, while hauling in one reception for -2 yards. Usually, Donaldson is an afterthought in the backfield, but he could see an expanded role with Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) expected to miss some time. Alvin Kamara should be the lead back with Kendre Miller and Donaldson splitting up the backup role. Fantasy managers in deep leagues or dynasty formats should consider stashing Donaldson.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson - Signed to New Orleans' active roster
metadata.description: The Saints signed Donaldson from the practice squad to the active roster Friday.
metadata.analysis: Donaldson will join a Saints backfield that is led by Travis Etienne, with Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller providing depth at the position. Kamara didn't play in the Saints' Week 1 overtime loss to the Lions, with Donaldson being elevated from the practice squad and logging two carries for four yards and one catch for minus-2 yards. Kamara is available for Sunday's game against the Ravens, so Donaldson figures to see most of his playing time on special teams rather than on offense.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: Donaldson reverted to the Saints' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's official transaction log.
metadata.analysis: The running back was elevated for New Orleans' 31-30 loss to Detroit with Alvin Kamara (knee) and Audric Estime (thigh) both out. Donaldson played a third-string role behind Travis Etienne and Kendre Miller, seeing 15 offensive snaps and recording two carries for four yards and one catch for -2 yards. The Ohio State product also played 20 snaps on special teams.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson sees three touches in Week 1
metadata.description: CJ Donaldson rushed twice for four yards while also catching one of his two targets for a loss to two yards in the Saints' 31-30 loss to the Detroit Lions in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: Donaldson was minimally involved despite the New Orleans backfield group missing Alvin Kamara and Audric Estime, as both Travis Etienne Jr. and Kendre Miller saw more touches from head coach Kellen Moore. The running back can remain off rosters in all formats, with a Week 2 contest against the Baltimore Ravens up next.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson - Elevated for Sunday
metadata.description: The Saints have elevated Donaldson from the practice squad to the active roster ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.
metadata.analysis: Donaldson signed with the Saints' practice squad Sept. 2 after being a casualty of the team's Aug. 30 cuts. The running back will fill in for Audric Estime (thigh) as a reserve option behind Travis Etienne, Alvin Kamara (knee), and Kendre Miller while Estime recovers from his thigh issue on IR.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson - Signs onto Saints' practice squad
metadata.description: New Orleans signed Donaldson to its practice squad Monday.
metadata.analysis: Donaldson cleared waivers after getting cut by the Saints on Sunday, and now he's back with the club as a practice squadder. The undrafted rookie will have to wait to be elevated to potentially make his regular-season debut in 2026.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson signs with Saints as UDFA
metadata.description: The Saints signed Ohio State RB CJ Donaldson as an undrafted free agent.
metadata.analysis: Donaldson began his collegiate career at West Virginia before he transferred to Ohio State. He did not hold a big role in the passing game during his collegiate career. He will compete for a depth role at the next level.

metadata.title: CJ Donaldson - Signing with New Orleans
metadata.description: The Saints signed Donaldson as an undrafted free agent Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Donaldson played in 13 games for Ohio State in 2025, logging 96 carries for 361 yards and 10 rushing touchdowns over his senior season. The 21-year-old spent the first three years of his collegiate career at West Virginia, logging 171 and 163 carries in his sophomore and junior seasons, respectively. As a well-built downhill back, his upside for the Saints comes as a depth option for short-yardage situations.
